why: Three slots that feed neither commander, flagged by the pilot on 2026-10-02 (Kefnet, Waterbender) and by the same sweep (Silent Hallcreeper), each replaced by a two- or three-drop that punishes the OPPONENTS' half of a wheel. Waterbender was already cut in tax-v1 (2026-09-14, card value +0.000) but tax-v1 was never merged and is now 17 cards stale; its pricing of Razorkin (+2.46 ping) and Scrawling Crawler (+1.97) is reused here. Kefnet came in through brief.json's must_include core and so never got the builder's filler check. Curve held: 3,2,2 out for 3,2,2 in, because 82% of the champion's stall turns are MANA-short.
